cleansingStrength.rationale: Strong by C1: defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate @2 (ether type) with prominent reinforcing strong anionics of the same type: Sodium Laureth-8 Sulfate @14 and Magnesium Laureth-8 Sulfate @17 (C3b, strong ether type with high-EO counter-signal), Magnesium Laureth Sulfate @16, Sodium Oleth Sulfate @19 and Magnesium Oleth Sulfate @20 (alkyl ether sulfates). A reinforcing route makes C1 strong regardless of buffers. The C3b laureth-8 cap does not apply (the formula stays strong even if the laureth-8 sulfates were read as buffers, because Magnesium Laureth Sulfate @16 and the oleth sulfates still reinforce). Counter-signals lower confidence to moderate: the reinforcing ether sulfates are all listed late (@14-20, after Menthol @12 and Glycerin @13, i.e. a minor co-surfactant blend), and the chassis is well buffered (Cocamidopropyl Betaine @3, Coco-Glucoside @5, Sodium Cocoyl Glutamate @6) with Glyceryl Oleate @7 refatting; moderate is the neighbor.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Reinforcing ether sulfates are late (@14-20) and the chassis is buffered (betaine @3, glucoside @5, glutamate @6) with Glyceryl Oleate @7.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Low: cleansing-led architecture with no cationic polymer, silicone or payload lipid; only weak refatters (Glyceryl Oleate @7, Hydrogenated Vegetable Glycerides Citrate @22), a pearlizer (Glycol Distearate @15) and humectants (Panthenol @10, Glycerin @13). C2 not met (no silicone/lipid, no cationic polymer).
